title: AI Visibility Checklist for Restoration Companies
intro: Use this self-check with your team or agency. Mark each item Done, Needs work, or Not checked. It is a way to organize useful next steps, not a visibility score or a promise of AI placement.

sections.title: Make your business easy to identify
items: Check that your business name, phone number, website, and genuine service areas agree across your website, Google Business Profile, and key listings.
Confirm your Business Profile is verified and has accurate categories, services, hours, and contact details. Represent the areas you actually serve.
Make water, fire, mold, and other services you genuinely offer easy to find. Explain coverage, availability, and how a property owner can reach you.

sections.title: Give people and answer engines useful evidence
items: Review your main service pages for clear explanations of your process and the questions customers actually ask. Fix missing or misleading information before adding more pages.
Support claims with real project examples, permitted photos, current credentials, and authentic customer feedback. Avoid promises you cannot substantiate.
Ask your web team to check that important text and links are accessible, pages can be indexed, and structured data accurately describes visible content.

sections.title: Check discovery and measure what happens
items: Ask your web team to review crawler access and security rules. OAI-SearchBot controls ChatGPT search discovery separately from GPTBot training access. Access does not guarantee inclusion.
Choose a small set of realistic service-and-location questions. Record the exact question, date, assistant, and location context when checking answers.
Record brand mentions separately from links that cite your website. Save the answer or screenshot; one result is not a stable ranking.
Review referrals, calls, forms, and booked work alongside visibility. Pick the next change from an observed gap, then recheck comparable questions over time.

closing: Choose one observed gap to work on first. A missing check means you need evidence, not that your visibility is zero. No checklist can guarantee rankings, AI answers, citations, or leads.
